sections.name: hook
sections.instructions: One short paragraph: why this role at {company} appeals to the candidate, tied to the main challenge the role solves. Under 70 words.

sections.name: fit
sections.instructions: One or two paragraphs: two or three concrete examples from the resume that show the candidate can handle the job's key responsibilities.

sections.name: closing
sections.instructions: One short paragraph: what the candidate would contribute in the first months, and a request for a conversation.
